issue_request: FHIR-17991 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core-PaymentNotice and requested PaymentNotice search description updates: change the created description typo from 'fro' to 'for', and replace the request/response descriptions with wording that describes the payment request and response resources.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-17991 was found in the relevant PaymentNotice source history. The 2021 source rework introduced the PaymentNotice search parameter bundle with 'Creation date fro the notice', 'The Claim', and 'The ClaimResponse'. Commit f4af0bcf79 later corrected only the created typo to 'for', leaving request and response ambiguous.
additional_context: PaymentNotice is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Jira FHIR-53920, Resolved - change required/Persuasive with Modification for R6, confirms the current Claim/ClaimResponse wording is misleading because PaymentNotice.request and PaymentNotice.response are Reference(Any), and resolves to generic descriptions rather than narrowing the element types. No relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found.
reconciliation: Updated source/paymentnotice/bundle-PaymentNotice-search-params.xml so PaymentNotice.request says 'The request resource' and PaymentNotice.response says 'The response to the request resource'. The created search description already said 'Creation date for the notice', so no created change was needed.
